title: Книга рецептов
prompt:
Japanese stationery sticker for a kanji study app, same art style as textbook.png and notebook.png: soft sculpted volume, three-quarter view from slightly above, matte materials, rounded forms, clean dark forest-green outline of even thickness, warm ivory paper, sage green, one small muted terracotta accent, light from top-left, soft self-shadow only. Friendly illustrated object, not photo, not flat icon. Clear silhouette readable at 64px. One centered object about 80% of square canvas. True transparent background with alpha. No text, letters, kanji, logos, watermarks, sticker border, drop shadow.

PRIMARY SUBJECT: a SLIM recipe binder / card album, obviously different from the thick closed textbook. Soft sage-green matte cover, cream label plate on the front without text, cream page/divider edges visible at the top, small terracotta bookmark tab on the spine. No spiral binding, no grid paper, no pencil, no inkstone, no thick textbook page block.
postprocess: Key near-white background to alpha; save PNG 1024×1024 RGBA; 64 px preview in doc/verification/stationery/
